registrations.name: ROT10
registrations.rule: Monthly at month-end close, execute next open: universe = top-200 by 63d avg dollar-volume, price>=20, 12-1 momentum (c[-21]/c[-252]-1) capped <=200%; hold top-10 equal-weight. DANGER/CRISIS: freeze (hold, no rotation). No stops.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 trading days AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK MDD in the window
registrations.kill: -20pp cumulative vs XLK at any point
registrations.context_at_registration: registered 19 days into a momentum crash; backtest OOS +17.8pp vs QQQ (tier B, in-sample-searched); live first-19d: -13.7pp vs QQQ

registrations.name: MOMBRK5
registrations.rule: Daily: Minervini gate (px 10-200, > SMA50/150/200 stacked, within 5% of 252d high, low>252d low+30%, ret20>5%, daychg<10%, ret5<=15%), rank by 126d return, top-5, enter next open, Fixed90d exit. Only in HEALTHY/PULLBACK/DIP_BUY regimes.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d in >=55% of windows over >=126 td

registrations.name: MRDIP
registrations.rule: MR strict gate (RSI2<10, >SMA50, ATR 3-15%, buf>=5%, vol>=1x, RSI14<60, px>=10), composite-ranked top-5, next-open entry, Fixed42d exit. Deploy ONLY in DIP_BUY/SHARP_DROP/BEAR_BOUNCE. Earnings<=7d veto.
registrations.promotion: positive mean edge vs XLK across its deployment windows, >=20 closed positions
registrations.kill: mean edge < -2pp per deployment after 20 positions

registrations.name: V4BLEND
registrations.rule: 50% core (XLK) + 50% ROT10, monthly rebalance to weights; MRDIP overlay funded from core (max 2x10%); DANGER/CRISIS = no new buys, no rotation.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK cumulative at >=126 td with MDD <= 1.3x XLK

registrations.name: HYB21
registrations.rule: MR strict gate (RSI2<10, >SMA50, ATR 3-15%, buf>=5%, vol>=1x, RSI14<60, px>=10), composite-ranked top-5, next-open entry, ALL non-paused regimes (not dip-gated). Exit = Hybrid21d: hold >=7d; from day 7, if pnl>5% trail -3% from peak (close basis); hard cap 21 trading days. No stops otherwise.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 td AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK
registrations.context_at_registration: Rules predate 2026 (V3.1 prod era) -> 2026 YTD is semi-clean OOS: $100K sim +54.2% YTD vs XLK +18.6 (best of all 21). 10-yr SR only 0.64 — registered to settle whether 2026 regime-fit is real. Cohort dsr_n now 5 for all candidates.

registrations.name: TREND10
registrations.rule: Monthly (rank at month-end close, execute next open): universe = top-300 by 63d avg dollar-volume with price>=$15 and dollar-vol>$3M. Filter: close > SMA200 AND close > SMA50 AND close/252d-high > 0.90. Rank survivors by 126d return; hold top-10 equal-weight until next month-end. No stops, no intramonth exits.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 td AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK MDD
registrations.context_at_registration: BACKTEST: 17-window WF compounded +992%, median +11.2%, worst -23.7%, 65% positive; decade $100K -> $1.62M vs XLK $772K; beat XLK 5 of last 7 yrs incl 2026 YTD +74.6% vs +18.6% and 2022 -17.7% vs -29.1%. DSR 0.948 at N=12 — JUST BELOW the 0.95 gate, so NOT statistically proven. Tier-B survivorship (trend-following is the most survivor-sensitive family; live analog MTUM/SPMO ~ index). Concentration-sensitive: top5 $5.2M vs top25 $749K. Lags in calm bulls (2017/2019/2021/2023 all lost to XLK), -19.4% in 2018.

registrations.name: RELSTR10
registrations.rule: Monthly (rank at month-end close, execute next open): universe = top-300 by 63d avg dollar-volume, price>=$15, dollar-vol>$3M. Keep names whose 252d return AND 63d return both exceed XLK's over the same windows; rank by 252d return; hold top-10 equal-weight. No sector cap, no stops, no intramonth exits.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 td AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK MDD
registrations.context_at_registration: OFFICIAL HARNESS (_master_harness3.py, null-check passed 0.0%): IS 20.0% / OOS 42.4% CAGR, OOS MDD -41.3%, +11.5pp vs QQQ. Tier B (survivor universe = ceiling). DSR 0.475 at N=27 — FAILS luck gate. WF median -0.6% with only 47% positive windows: decade result is a few explosive windows, not consistency. Concentration is the engine AND the risk: July 2026 book was 8/10 AI-memory/semis, -34.1% in 30 days, -40.2% from the June peak. Sector caps and guardrails were tested and REDUCED returns (cap2 OOS 24.6%, cap2+stop15+DD12 OOS 19.5%) while cutting drawdown -41.3%->-26.1%.

registrations.name: MIX9
registrations.rule: Daily regime read (prod _check_market_regime chain incl. VIX tiers). Map regime -> active strategy, FROZEN from IS-only (2016-06..2022-12) mean daily return per regime: HEALTHY->MOM-breakout-F90, PULLBACK->TREND10, SHARP_DROP->TREND10, FEAR->TREND10, DANGER->RELSTR10, CORRECTION->RELSTR10, DIP_BUY->LeadingSector, BEAR_BOUNCE->RELSTR10-cap2+guard, CRISIS->LC-12-1, WEAK->MR-dips-F90. Allocation: 70% active strategy + 30% XLK core, rebalanced monthly. GUARDRAIL: if the active strategy's own equity is >15% below its running peak, its 70% sleeve sits in XLK until that strategy recovers above the threshold. No position-level stops.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 td AND MDD <= 1.2x XLK MDD
registrations.kill: -20pp cumulative vs XLK, or 3 consecutive months below benchmark
registrations.measurement: journal (backend/data/forward_journal/MIX9.jsonl) — records regime, active strategy, guard state, picks
registrations.context_at_registration: Regime-switch + per-strategy DD-stop(15%) + 30% XLK core. OFFICIAL: OOS(2023+) CAGR 40.7% vs XLK 34.2%, OOS Sharpe 1.41 vs 1.34, beat XLK 8/10 calendar years, $100K->$3.83M vs XLK $889K, MDD -35.4% vs XLK -34.0%, 2026 YTD +23.6% vs +21.8% with YTD MDD -12.0% vs -16.0%. DSR 0.680 at N=40 — FAILS luck gate (edge 1.41 vs 1.34 Sharpe is inside the 1.16 luck bar). CONTAMINATION: regime map fitted on IS 2016-22, AND this rule was selected after comparing 16 mixing variants over the full period — double selection bias. Tier B. ~32 strategy switches/yr = heavy tax at 25% CGT (unmodeled). Sub-strategies are 0.79-0.90 correlated; MR-dips (corr 0.22-0.51) is the only true diversifier. Rules that FAILED and must not be silently substituted: chasing the 126d-best strategy (OOS 25.8%, YTD -0.3%), equal-weight blending (32.5%), inverse-vol (29.1%), vol-targeting (22.6%).
